title: universal unit shift
statement: Let U:C→D commute with integer shifts. If p:F→U(H) induces bijections Hom(H,K)→Hom(F,U(K)) for every K, then for every integer n its shifted map p[n] followed by the inverse commutation with shift induces bijections Hom(H[n],K)→Hom(F[n],U(K)) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: First test on shifted objects K[n]. The shift functors are fully faithful, so the original Hom bijection transfers to these tests; commutation with shift gives the specified formula. Every object is isomorphic to a shifted object by shifting back and forward. Naturality transports the bijection to an arbitrary test object.
